final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), shares AS (SELECT gender, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM gender_counts) SELECT gender, order_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average FROM shares WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
